title: Delicate and well made
detail: Finer than the photos suggest, in a good way. The finish is flawless.

title: Lovely, a little small
detail: Beautiful piece. The pendant is smaller than I expected, so check the size.

title: Worn every day
detail: Six months in, no tarnish, no loose stone.

title: Perfect gift
detail: The box and the handwritten card made it. She cried.

title: Clasp is secure
detail: Lobster clasp with a proper spring. Never opened by itself.

title: Resized for free
detail: Half a size out. Sent back, resized, returned within a week.

title: Catches the light
detail: The stone sparkles under office lights. Colleagues noticed.

title: Chain is fine
detail: Beautiful but very fine. I take it off for the gym.

title: Stacks well
detail: Three thin rings, worn together. That was the plan and it works.

title: Earring back is tiny
detail: Lovely hoops but the backs are small and easy to drop.

title: Solid gold, not plated
detail: You can feel the weight. Worth every penny.

title: Slight scratch on the band
detail: Hairline mark out of the box. Polished it out myself.

title: Pearls are matched
detail: Same size, same lustre, well knotted between each.

title: Fits the wrist
detail: Cuff opens just enough. Stays put all day.

title: Ring box is lovely
detail: The linen box is a keepsake on its own.

title: Wanted it bigger
detail: Beautiful stone, smaller than the photo led me to expect.

title: No green finger
detail: A month of daily wear, no mark on the skin.

title: Engraving is crisp
detail: Two initials and a date, clean and even.

title: Bought a second for my sister
detail: She saw mine and now we match.

title: Post is short
detail: Stud sits close to the ear, which I like. Bigger lobes may want longer posts.

title: Came with a cloth
detail: Polishing cloth and care notes in the box. Thoughtful.
